"No audit may begin on less than 30 days' written notice, and the Client may not audit the Contractor more than once in a calendar year unless the previous audit found a material breach. Action: give the Client's auditors access to the relevant records
items.why: The previous audit found a material breach, so a further audit this year must be given access.

Clause 7.7 of the agreement between Orchard Health (the "Vendor") and Juniper Freight (the "Buyer"):
"The Vendor has no obligation to replace or refund damaged Goods unless the Buyer reports the damage in writing within 10 business days of delivery, and in no case for damage caused by the Buyer's own handling after delivery. Subject to that, it shall replace the damaged Goods or refund their price, whichever the Buyer elects."

Situation: A pallet of ceramic tiles arrived cracked because the carrier's truck braked hard. The Buyer emailed the Vendor 3 business days after delivery and asked for its money back for the damaged items.

Party: the Vendor
Action: replace the damaged goods
items.why: The counterparty chose a refund, so the duty is to refund, not to replace.
